Hi Iago,

yes, you are right - I have been trying to obtain an arm64 system from Hetzner 
since the publication of R 4.6.1, but their hardware seems to be fully booked 
for this platform, so I need to look elsewhere for building an arm64.

I am currently travelling, but will upload R 4.6.1 for amd64 tomorrow evening. 
Will that work for you?

Sorry for the inconvenience,

Johannes
